title: Lessons from The Years of Lyndon Johnson by Robert Caro [Narration]
subtitle: "Explore a single individual deeply enough and truths about all individuals emerge." - Robert Caro
body:
This is a narration of my blog post, Lessons from The Years of Lyndon Johnson by Robert Caro.

You read the full post here: https://www.dwarkeshpatel.com/p/lyndon-johnson
